Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_binary_message.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":21,"var":"data,size","code":"UA_memoryManager_setLimitFromLast4Bytes(data, size)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are accepted as the fuzz input and the last four bytes are reserved for the memory-limit helper, leaving the rest as the message payload."},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_binary_message.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":41,"var":"msg.data","code":"memcpy(msg.data, data, size)","note":"The payload bytes are copied verbatim into a heap buffer that becomes the packet passed into the server parser."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/server/ua_server_binary.c","function":"UA_Server_processBinaryMessage","line":783,"var":"message","code":"UA_Connection_processChunks(connection, server, processCompleteChunk, message)","note":"The server hands the attacker-controlled packet to the chunk processor, which will decode complete OPC UA chunks from it."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/server/ua_connection.c","function":"processChunk","line":129,"var":"chunk_length","code":"UA_UInt32_decodeBinary(&temp, &temp_offset, &chunk_length)","note":"The chunk header length is decoded from the input and used to decide whether the chunk is complete and should be forwarded for decoding."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/server/ua_server_binary.c","function":"processCompleteChunkWithoutChannel","line":700,"var":"request","code":"UA_decodeBinary(msg, &offset, request, requestType, server->config.customDataTypes)","note":"A complete message body is decoded into a typed request object, so nested arrays and strings are allocated from attacker-controlled lengths and contents."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"Array_decodeBinary","line":479,"var":"signed_length","code":"DECODE_DIRECT(&signed_length, UInt32)","note":"Array lengths inside the decoded request are read directly from the message and determine how much memory is allocated and how many elements are decoded."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"Array_decodeBinary","line":494,"var":"*dst","code":"*dst = UA_calloc(length, type->memSize)","note":"The decoder allocates heap storage for the attacker-sized array before populating each element."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"Array_decodeBinary","line":504,"var":"ret","code":"ret = decodeBinaryJumpTable[type->typeKind]((void*)ptr, type, ctx)","note":"Each array element is recursively decoded, so a later element can fail after earlier elements have already been initialized."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"Array_decodeBinary","line":507,"var":"*dst","code":"UA_Array_delete(*dst, i+1, type)","note":"On a partial decode failure, the decoder frees the already-initialized prefix of the array, including nested strings and structures."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":139,"var":"s->data","code":"UA_Array_delete(s->data, s->length, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_BYTE])","note":"String cleanup releases the byte buffer for each decoded string field as part of the array teardown."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"clearStructure","line":996,"var":"ptr","code":"UA_Array_delete(*(void**)ptr, length, mt)","note":"Structure cleanup walks members and frees nested arrays/strings, so the same decoded string can be released again if the parent structure is cleared after the partial-array cleanup."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src/pubsub/ua_pubsub_networkmessage.c","function":"UA_NetworkMessage_deleteMembers","line":822,"var":"p","code":"UA_NetworkMessage_deleteMembers(p)","note":"The network-message destructor clears the decoded message object after decode failure, triggering cleanup of fields that were already freed during recursive array teardown and leading to the use-after-free read reported in the crash state."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541/tests/fuzz/fuzz_binary_message.cc /workspace/candidate_trace.json
